_meta.note: Real structure from the connected accounts. Used by FixtureDriver so the spine is exercised against true data shapes without touching the network. Metrics are NOT captured here - only structure and health - because metric fixtures go stale silently and invite false confidence.
observed_findings: Neither funded account has any dataset (pixel). Offline conversion upload and CAPI deduplication - the closed loop this product is built on - cannot run until one exists.
Ad sets carry Meta's auto-generated default names, three of them identical ('New Leads Ad Set'). Nothing downstream can tell them apart in a report.

Four campaigns on one account and two on the other, each with a single ad set. This is the fragmentation pattern PRD 15.1 names as the most common cause of permanent learning-limited status in small accounts.
'Piles 2' and 'Piles2' are near-duplicate campaign names on the same account.

ad_accounts.note: Designated write target. No payment method attached, so even an accidental activation cannot spend.
